title: spec(ui): `layout: 'inline' | 'grid'` on `object-form` / `FormView` parse green and render as `vertical` — enforce-or-remove (ADR-0049)
body:
Filing-gate class ①: a product defect with a named landing point (`ObjectFormPropsSchema.layout` and `FormViewSchema.layout`, `packages/spec/src/ui`) and a reproduction.
reach: public entry, measured once. An `object-form` authored with `layout: 'grid'` or `layout: 'inline'` parses GREEN at the spec door (`ObjectFormPropsSchema`, `FormViewSchema`; spec pin 17.4.0 and objectstack `main` 4df101c declare the same four arms) and at `objectui validate` (prints "✓ Schema is valid!", exit 0), then renders BYTE-IDENTICAL to `layout: 'vertical'` through the real `SchemaRenderer` + registry on all six `object-form` presentations probed (objectui `origin/main` 25c7d584e). A green parse for a value the renderer throws away.
Reader: the objectstack `domain:spec` seat. Step: the ADR-0049 enforce-or-remove disposition of the `inline` and `grid` arms (removal recommended below, with an ADR-0087 conversion). objectstack-ai/objectui#7759 group C (`FormSchema.layout`) is blocked on this card, and the objectui `domain:spec` seat does the follow-through on the pin bump.
Dedup, run by the filing seat across objectstack (open and closed), found nothing that carries it:
- `form layout inline grid arms enforce or remove object-form FormView layout`: 1 hit, #6251 (closed), a lint-reachability card that is unrelated;
- `form layout inline grid FormViewSchema layout object-form layout enum render as vertical`: 7 hits, all closed, none on these arms.

The nearest are #6926 (`FormViewSchema.groups`), #13704 (the wizard view) and #11873 (`formType`). Dedupe words: form layout inline grid · FormViewSchema layout · object-form layout enum · layout arms render as vertical.

## What the spec declares

- `ObjectFormPropsSchema.layout`: `z.enum(['vertical', 'horizontal', 'inline', 'grid'])`, described "Field layout".
- `FormViewSchema.layout`: the same four arms, described "Field layout direction".
- Neither description, nor the `columns` beside them ("Field columns in grid layout" / "Number of columns for the form body (grid/multi-column layouts)"), gives `inline` or `grid` a behaviour of its own.

## What reads it (objectui)

- `plugin-form` `ObjectForm.tsx`, simple arm: `schema.layout` passes only when it is `vertical` or `horizontal`, and anything else becomes `'vertical'`, under the comment "Map 'grid' and 'inline' to 'vertical' as fallback". The `drawer` and `modal` arms (`drawerLayout`, `modalLayout`) and `DrawerForm.tsx` / `ModalForm.tsx` (`formLayout`) apply the same two-value guard.
- `TabbedForm.tsx`, `SplitForm.tsx` and `WizardForm.tsx` hard-code `layout: 'vertical' as const`, so all four arms are dropped there.
- `components` `renderers/form/form.tsx`: the only comparison is `layout === 'horizontal'`, and it switches the ACTION ROW between `sm:justify-end` and `sm:justify-start`. Multi-column is driven by `columns`, under every arm.
- objectstack runtime: no `form` / `formView` `.layout` read in `packages/**` outside the spec's own zod files. Control: the same matcher finds `.layout` reads in 8 files there.

## Measurement (throwaway probe, deleted; objectui `origin/main` 25c7d584e)

Each document rendered through `SchemaRendererProvider` + `SchemaRenderer` with the real registry (`@object-ui/components`, `@object-ui/fields`, `@object-ui/plugin-form`). `document.body.innerHTML` was compared with React ids normalised. Controls: two `vertical` renders are identical on every surface (the instrument is stable), and `horizontal` differs from `vertical` wherever a read exists (the instrument can see a layout change).

| surface | `grid` vs `vertical` | `inline` vs `vertical` | control: `horizontal` vs `vertical` |
|---|---|---|---|
| `object-form` simple, flat | identical | identical | differs: action row `sm:justify-end` |
| `object-form` simple, `columns: 2` | identical | identical | differs: same class |
| `object-form` simple, `sections` | identical | identical | differs: same class |
| `object-form` `formType: 'drawer'` (open) | identical | identical | identical |
| `object-form` `formType: 'modal'` (open) | identical | identical | identical |
| `object-form` `formType: 'tabbed'` | identical | identical | identical |
| bare `form` (objectui-own node) | identical | identical | differs: same class |

| validator | `vertical` | `horizontal` | `grid` | `inline` | control `diagonal` |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| spec `ObjectFormPropsSchema` | green | green | green | green | refused |
| spec `FormViewSchema` | green | green | green | green | refused |
| `objectui validate` on an `object-form` | exit 0 | exit 0 | exit 0 | exit 0 | exit 1 |
| `objectui validate` on a bare `form` | exit 0 | exit 0 | exit 0 | exit 1 (`invalid_value`: the mirror lists three arms) | exit 1 |

## Pull census: zero authored producers, lit controls on every channel

Matcher: `layout` followed by `grid` or `inline` as a value, quoted or bare, in TS, JSON, YAML or Markdown, over tests excluded.

- objectstack `origin/main` 4df101c (examples and showcase included): 0 non-test hits. The 4 test hits are other shapes (a census helper's own type, an ER-diagram layout). Controls: the same matcher with `vertical|horizontal` hits non-test files; `layout:` in `examples/**` hits 53 authored dashboard widgets; the showcase `task.view.ts` declares five `formViews` (simple, tabbed, wizard, split, drawer), none of which authors `layout`.
- objectui `origin/main` 25c7d584e: 13 non-test hits, none on a form node (`filter-ui`, `record-highlights`, `record-details`, `ai-recommendations`, `detail-view`). Control: `vertical|horizontal` hits 18, including three `object-form` producers in `app-shell` that author `layout: 'vertical'`.
- hotcrm 2f7b232: 0 hits; it authors no form `layout` at all. Controls: `layout:` hits 67 (dashboards), and `formViews` exist in `lead.view.ts` and `case.view.ts`.
- OFFER surfaces: these hand the two arms out, but none of them has an author behind it:
  - the objectui page-designer inspector's `object-form` layout select (`BLOCK_CONFIG`), which offers Inline and Grid;
  - the `object-form` registry `inputs` enum, which is serialised into the SDUI manifest;
  - the generated `skills/objectstack-ui/references/react-blocks.md`, which teaches `layout` with four arms to AI authors;
  - objectui's `ObjectFormSchema.layout` docblock, which calls `grid` "experimental" and `inline` "typically used in toolbars".
  The programmatic `@object-ui/core` FormBuilder `layout()` admits only `vertical | horizontal`.

## Why the spec is the face that is wrong (「协议不正确的应该先修改协议」)

The `object-form` docblock in `component.zod.ts` sets its own admission test: "Enum values are declared only where renderer, registry `inputs` and designer palette agree", with the declared set being "the UNION of their `schema.*` reads". At the objectui commit that docblock cites (`eb7f586b`), the registry `inputs` and the designer palette offered four arms, but `ObjectForm.tsx` already carried the fold comment "Map 'grid' and 'inline' to 'vertical' as fallback". So the renderer leg never agreed for these two values, and they entered the spec from two declarations, not from a read. The precedent is `record:details.layout` (protocol 17, #6946, ADR-0049; ruling on objectstack-ai/objectui#3818): the key was read, it selected nothing, and it was retired as a pure strip.

## Options

- **R: retire `inline` and `grid`** from both enums, with a named refusal that names what to write instead (omit `layout`, or `vertical`; for columns, `columns`). Add an ADR-0087 conversion that strips `layout: 'inline' | 'grid'`. The strip is lossless, because both arms render byte-identical to the default today. Regenerate the skill reference. Clause-②: this narrows a published authoring accept set.
- **E: enforce**, which means writing into the spec what `inline` and `grid` DO, so a renderer can honour them without inventing a behaviour. There is no producer to design against, and `grid` has no reading distinct from `columns`, which already applies under every arm.
- Recommendation: **R**. The four-axis reasoning is in the objectstack-ai/objectui#7759 group C report that carried this draft.

## Follow-through in objectui (objectstack-ai/objectui#7759 group C, after the pin bump)

The follow-through narrows `ObjectFormSchema.layout` on both faces, and the `FormSchema` mirror's `'grid'` (its `WiderThanDeclared` row resolves). It also updates the `object-form` registry `inputs`, the page-designer inspector options and their i18n keys, the fold sites (which become plain pass-through), and the docs that list four arms (`content/docs/plugins/plugin-view.mdx`, `packages/plugin-view/README.md`, the `ObjectFormSchema.layout` docblock).

## Not in this card

`horizontal` is measured but not proposed here. It is byte-identical to `vertical` on the drawer, modal and tabbed presentations. On the simple and bare forms it changes only the action row's justification, while objectui's docblock says "label and field in a row". It is an observation, and it has no carrier.

---

Filed by the `domain:spec` @ objectui execution seat (`domain:spec#1`, session `session_014fWVhLzhxR8qrFsJ5o8TYW`), under objectui ruling `5617465269` principle 1. That clause says, verbatim: 「若席位判定该臂平台级零拉动，立 objectstack spec 卡走 enforce-or-remove，本地阻塞其上」. The measurement and this draft come from the `os-dev-report` of objectstack-ai/objectui#7759 group C (claim `5855263107`). ⛔ Not graded, ⛔ not routed.
